_comment: OMN-16999. A RECORDED /v1/models readback per authorized lab endpoint.
This file is the evidence that pins _AUTHORIZED_BINDINGS to live truth.
It exists because the .201 served id has now flipped TWICE with nothing in
the repo able to notice: OMN-16419 changed it Qwen3.6-35B-A3B -> qwen3.8 on
2026-08-23 after a reboot, and by 2026-09-05 the endpoint had been redeployed
SGLang -> vLLM and served Qwen3.6-35B-A3B again. Both times every static test
stayed green while every local delegation attempt was refused by the
OMN-16419 fail-closed attribution guard and climbed to the metered ceiling.
UPDATING THIS FILE IS THE POINT, NOT A CHORE. When an endpoint is
re-deployed, re-probe it and paste the readback here in the same commit that
changes the binding table. Never edit the binding table alone: the paired
test asserts the two agree, so an unaccompanied edit fails CI instead of
shipping a rung that 404s on its first call.
Never hand-write a `served_model_ids` list. It must be the `data[].id` values

probes.control: Negative control run in the same session with the same curl invocation: http://192.168.86.201:8001/v1/models returns curl exit 7, http=000 in 0.035s. So the http=200 in 0.012s on :8000 is that port answering, not a proxy answering everything.
probes.revalidation_note: OMN-18626. THE THIRD FLIP, and the second one to leave the local tier dark. The operator swapped the served model on 2026-09-17 at about 15:24Z, roughly four hours after OMN-18570 recorded the readback this entry replaces. /v1/models now returns exactly one id, Qwen3.8-27B, rooted at the NVFP4 weight set that OMN-18570 found staged on disk and loaded by nothing. The flip was found by a real delegation, not by this file: run 95df150b-21cc-4b0e-afc6-9e25fbeb3735 at 19:52Z had its local rung refused with HTTP 404 'The model `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` does not exist.' and climbed to a metered cheap_cloud rung. That is the cost of this record going stale — a recorded readback cannot notice that the thing it recorded has moved, so the binding table it pins stays confidently wrong until something calls the endpoint for real.

probes.curl_error: Failed to connect to 192.168.86.200 port 8101 after 11 ms: Couldn't connect to server
probes.control: http=000 is indistinguishable from a probe that never ran, so it carries its own controls (CLAUDE.md rule 16): ping 192.168.86.200 = 2/2 packets received, 0.0% loss, 0.189ms avg; TCP 22 OPEN while TCP 8101 and 8000 are CLOSED; `ssh jonah@192.168.86.200 hostname` returns Stickybeatz-Studio.local, i.e. .200 is the workstation itself, and `ps aux | grep -i 'ds4|llama|vllm|sglang'` returns no rows there. The host is healthy; the model server is not running. Nothing was restarted (read-only scope).
probes.declared_note: Recorded from the OMN-16833 2026-08-28 readback. Retained so the rung is restored by flipping `serving`, not by reconstructing the binding. It is NOT treated as a live readback by the paired test.
